Independently extracted and executed the unchanged SQL in a fresh in-memory SQLite schema: later empty hash and height return null; historical and latest return the same constructor row. This validates the query mechanism, not a historical live response or image reproducibility.

After the historical native/canonical receipt watch, a fresh indexed tip must exactly match its finalized hash/height and be <=60 seconds old. A separately read node finalized head/header must match it, must not regress below historical finality or the initial tip, and must remain within the existing two-block initial-tip bound. Then fresh indexed/finalized coverage must have the same hash and height, followed by a final node finalized-head equality check. A changed state, missing state, mismatching coverage or moving head rejects before private work.
